deploybot: [deploybot] Deploy started: service=runtime env=prod-eu1 tag=release-2026-10-12-v2.7.4 commit=abc123def change_window=2026-10-12T02:00Z-03:00Z rolling_to=4 instances. CI/status: green. release-notes: small kv-cache tweak + perf patch.
alice: Noting 95p latency spike on /v1/generate after canary shift, 420ms -> 1.2s. Grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/ops/latency (canary group). cc @sre-oncall
jorge: Agree with alice. If kv-cache change is the culprit we should revert quickly. Can we pin traffic back to v2.7.3 and hold?
kai: Quick check of logs on canary nodes: cache-miss rate jumped to ~48% vs baseline ~12%. KV warmup path logging shows repeated cold loads.
sre-oncall: Per runbook, initiating rollback for prod-eu1 due to latency/regression. @deploybot please start rollback to release-v2.7.3 and create rollback_id. Ticket INC-5921 created.
deploybot: [deploybot] Rollback initiated: rollback_id=rb-20261012-01 target=release-v2.7.3 started_by=sre-oncall est_completion=5m command=`deploybot rollback --to release-v2.7.3 --id rb-20261012-01 --env prod-eu1` pausing autoscaler and canary traffic.
alice: Pinning routes in Console to release-v2.7.3 and disabling canary rollout. :thumbsup:
deploybot: [deploybot] Rollback completed: rollback_id=rb-20261012-01 duration=3m20s status=success nodes_reconciled=4 current_tag=release-v2.7.3 current_commit=xyz789 healthchecks=ok. Note: performed revert-deploy and repinned customer routes to avoid immediate re-forward.
eng-release: Filed follow-up REL-3456: investigate kv-cache warmup regression, add regression test and add a canary check for cache-miss >20%. Also schedule a narrow change window tomorrow to re-run canary with extra telemetry.
sre-oncall: Post-rollback metrics trending back to baseline, closing incident INC-5921. If anyone sees residual errors ping here. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
